Managed Web service demo
Starts a local asset service on opening and releases it when the page closes
PRoot Web service demo
Requires ready local Linux and /usr/bin/python3. Opens a dedicated asset process; switching systems or closing the page releases it. Dependencies are not installed automatically.
Read this page\'s service data

Sends one read-only request to the local service this plugin itself is bound to, returning at most 32768 characters. No host, port, scheme or credential may be chosen, and no other service is reachable.
Stream this page\'s service data

Reads the local service this plugin itself is bound to in bounded chunks, at most 65536 characters per stream; a spent budget or a revoked grant stops it. Also read-only, with no host, port, scheme or credential to choose.
